bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to child care; modifying process for closing a license; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 142B.25, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 142B.25, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 4.

Voluntarily closing a license.

A license holder that voluntarily stops providing child care services or does not renew the license issued under this chapter may choose not to return the license to the commissioner.
